application: Aero comparison workspace (section 2D and finite wing 3D)
supersedes: ml-airfoil long page (comparison.js, page.js, help.js) and the separate wing-comparison page; wing-comparison/index.html now redirects to ml-airfoil/#wing and its data files are unchanged
scope: One Wing Lab style workspace: side controls, central tabbed figure (Cp, Coefficients, Lift curve or Span, Screening or Prediction service), concise results strip, sources and limitations collapsible. Legends inside every figure; no bar charts.

solvers_and_models.section_panel: WingAirfoilPanel2D 1.1.0, linear-vortex stream-function panels (panel2d.js and panel-geometry.js unchanged, SHA-256 pinned in demo.json)
solvers_and_models.section_ml: ADAPT, Large Airfoil Model (PCA-input SVDKL Gaussian process), hwlee924/Large-Airfoil-Model commit 5353a862ec8c453788efef4e8aa8040148efbe6c, one checkpoint, recorded CPU inference in demo.json; two-dimensional only
solvers_and_models.wing_panel: WingAeroPanel 0.3.2-exp.4 (Wing AeroStruct surface-panel solver), recorded meshes in wing-comparison/benchmarks.json and browser re-solve through wing-comparison/worker.js
solvers_and_models.wing_ml: Large Wing Model (deep-kernel Gaussian process with LAM prior), hwlee924/Large-Wing-Model commit 4cca875b84b97571569070a8032ce304db3d7311, two checkpoints averaged, no conditioning on measured lift; three-dimensional only, never mixed with the section model
solvers_and_models.execution_provenance: UMass Unity, 2026-11-08, for the recorded LWM inference and panel solves; shown only in Sources and execution. Full-covariance inference for the two recorded wings (about 7400 points) took 44.84 s on 16 CPU threads after model preparation, a batch time, not per-design latency.

recorded_benchmarks.wing: NACA 0012 rectangular, alpha 8.85 deg, M 0.13, s/c 2.95, NASA TN D-8307
NACA 0015, alpha 4.1 deg, M 0.17, s/c 3.2882, NASA TP-3151 (tunnel-corrected Cp)

prediction_service.status: adapter only; no live model in this build and no cluster job started
prediction_service.client: lwm-client.js: canonical cache, domain gating, mean screening then full covariance for the top candidates, cold/warm timing, offline state
prediction_service.service: Protocol host and exact recorded replay; --runtime loads a user-supplied plugin. No real LWM runtime is implemented or weight-tested in this release.
prediction_service.honesty: no number is shown for a geometry the service did not answer; the mock refuses unrecorded cases

tests.browser: Independently exercised in the in-app browser: section/wing rendering and fresh 1152-panel solves for both reference wings. JSDOM regression separately checks references, worked examples, all controller paths, stale workers, mock screening and offline recovery.

limitations: Section ADAPT domain Re > 1e6, alpha -4 to 12 deg, Mach 0 to 0.9; Re is context only; recorded angles 0 to 12 deg in 0.1 deg steps for six section contexts
Reference CFD and wind-tunnel values appear only at their own angles and conditions; no interpolation; measured section lift is not available for the wing cases
Panel solvers: attached, incompressible, inviscid flow; no stall, boundary layer, viscous or total drag

Comparable but not identical geometries between panel (analytic closed trailing edge, rounded tip) and LWM (sampled section, implicit tip); NACA 0015 case uses tunnel-corrected Cp with a retained conditions discrepancy
No low-Reynolds, stall, structural, viscous-drag or flight-safety validation is implied
Independent-model consultation for this release was waived by the instructor; no consultation is recorded or claimed

independent_review.status: passed numerical and software checks; not general ML accuracy or physical-design validation
independent_review.real_runtime: Not supplied or weight-tested; plugin contract only
independent_review.mock: Recorded replay only; no synthetic model timing
independent_review.uncertainty: Full joint-covariance projection retained in recorded data; pointwise 2sigma is not a calibrated 95% guarantee
